name: AddToCollection
caption: Add to Collection

configuration.description: A single SmartField placeholder pointing to the output of a Create Collection step, e.g. "{{CreateOrdersCollection_Orders}}". Must be wrapped in {{ }} and must not contain a dotted path. Read unresolved (raw) at run time.

Item to append. Value collections: any SmartText (SmartFields {{..}}, SmartFormulas [[..]], SmartControls {#..#}); resolved before appending. Reference collections: exactly one SmartField placeholder {{name}} that resolves to an upstream Reference output of the same table.

The collection's element type, resolved from collectionSelector by the editor and persisted. The run time trusts this key alone: "reference" appends a record reference, anything else (including missing or empty) appends text. Must match the target collection's type.
Table number of the target collection (0 for Value collections or when unresolved). Written by the editor; informational at run time.

rules.check: collectionSelector must be a single wrapped SmartField placeholder: starts with {{ and ends with }} (after trimming) with a non-empty name inside.
rules.message: The Collection selector '%1' must use the SmartField placeholder notation, e.g. '{{name}}'.

rules.check: The name inside collectionSelector must not contain '.'; a collection must be a top-level output.
rules.message: The Collection selector '%1' must point to a top-level output – dotted paths cannot be collections.

rules.check: configuration.collectionSelector and configuration.value must both be non-empty (required fields in the configuration dialog), for Value and Reference collections alike.
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: When derivedType = "reference", the raw value must be a single wrapped {{name}} placeholder.
rules.message: Reference collections require a single SmartField placeholder for the Value, e.g. '{{name}}'. Got: %1

rules.check: When derivedType = "reference", the placeholder name must exist in the run context as a Reference.
The step must run inside a flow execution.

notes: No outputs of its own: it appends to the Create Collection step's output. Entries are written as <collectionOutputName>[0], [1], ... (first free index).

Nothing checks that the selector names a real collection or that a Reference item has the collection's table – not in the editor, not at publish. Only the generic dangling-reference warning ('Step "%1" references unknown slug "%2".') applies. When writing JSON by hand, set derivedType/derivedTableNo yourself and make sure they match the Create Collection step.

The editor derives derivedType/derivedTableNo when the dialog is saved. If the selector cannot be resolved at that moment, it writes derivedType "" and derivedTableNo 0, and items are then appended as text.
The selector is read unresolved, so {{...}} must name the full output, i.e. <CreateCollectionSlug>_<collectionName>.
